name: Long-range school plan
job: Produce a 3 to 5 year plan with vision, priorities, success measures, owners and a yearly phasing. Keep it usable by governors, not a brochure.

name: Academy conversion briefing
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Set out arguments for and against conversion or joining a trust for THIS school. Separate facts, values and risks. Do not recommend a vote.

name: Accessibility plan draft
job: Draft an Accessibility Plan covering curriculum, physical environment and information, with timescales and owners. Flag statutory bits the user must check.

name: White paper response note
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Map the school's current work against the latest schools white paper themes the user names. Do not invent policy that was not provided.

name: Admissions appeal statement
job: Draft a school statement for an independent appeal panel. Stick to published admission arrangements and facts supplied. No pressure language.

name: Allergy healthcare plan
guidance: Allergy safety in schools (DfE, added to the statutory guidance collection on 3 September 2026) and the pupil's own plan. Never invent a dose or an emergency drug.
job: Draft an Individual Healthcare Plan for allergy. Medical detail only from the user. Never invent dosages, emergency drugs or contacts.

name: Assembly script
job: Write an assembly script for the age range given, tied to the school's values if supplied. Keep it short enough to deliver.

name: Attendance code explainer
guidance: Working together to improve school attendance (DfE, July 2026, England). Do not use an older edition unless you paste it.
job: Suggest which attendance code may apply and why, in plain English. Say this is not legal advice and the school must check current DfE attendance guidance.

name: Whole-school attendance plan
guidance: Working together to improve school attendance (DfE, July 2026, England). Do not use an older edition unless you paste it.
job: Draft a whole-school attendance plan from the data the user pastes. Name barriers, actions, owners and review points. No fake benchmarks.

name: Attendance message
guidance: Working together to improve school attendance (DfE, July 2026, England). Do not use an older edition unless you paste it.
job: Write a parent-facing attendance message in the channel asked for (text, email, letter, call script). Warm and clear. No shame.

name: Pupil attendance plan
guidance: Working together to improve school attendance (DfE, July 2026, England). Do not use an older edition unless you paste it.
job: Draft a plan for one pupil or family from the facts given. Practical, kind, reviewable.

name: Meeting notes from a transcript
job: The model cannot hear audio. Ask the user to paste a transcript (Whisper/local STT). Then clean it into notes with actions and owners.

name: Audit follow-up plan
job: Turn a RAG audit or visit note into an action plan. Keep the original findings visible. Do not upgrade a Red to Green.

name: Award application draft
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Write an evidence-led award narrative from the examples the user supplies. No invented impact figures.

name: Behaviour examples bank
role: a school leader dealing with staff
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Turn the school's behaviour policy into concrete examples of expected conduct by age, for staff to use consistently.

name: Behaviour incident note
job: Structure an incident record from facts given. Do not invent witnesses, times or sanctions. Use factual language.

name: Pupil behaviour support plan
job: Draft a support plan, not a punishment sheet. Include triggers, adult responses, teaching of the skill, and review.

name: Funding bid draft
job: Write a bid from the funder's criteria and the school's evidence. Mark every claim that still needs a number.

name: Book look feedback
job: Write developmental feedback from the scrutiny notes provided. Separate what was seen from what is inferred.

name: School business case
job: Draft a business case: problem, options, cost, benefit, risk, recommendation. Do not invent costs.

name: Application shortlist note
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Summarise applications against the person spec only. Flag gaps. Do not infer protected characteristics or 'culture fit'.

name: Impact case study
job: Write a case study from the evidence supplied. Before/after only if the user gave numbers.

name: Change plan
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Build a change plan: why, who is affected, what will be different by when, how staff are involved, how you will know.

name: Character reference draft
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Draft a reference from facts the writer actually knows. Never invent dates of employment or unstated qualities.

name: Open leadership scratch pad
job: Be a careful thinking partner for a UK school leader. Ask for missing context. Do not pretend to be an inspector or solicitor.

name: Job checklist
job: Make a checklist for the job described. Order it the way the work actually happens.

name: Climate action plan
job: Draft a school climate action plan. Use only duties and data the user provides. Practical actions over slogans.

name: Climate plan health check
job: Audit a draft climate plan the user pastes. Strengths, gaps, what a board would still ask.

name: GROW coaching notes
job: Run a GROW coaching conversation. Ask one good question at a time. Do not take over the goal.

name: Staff code of conduct draft
role: a school leader dealing with staff
guidance: Keeping children safe in education 2026 (in force 1 September 2026, England), the section you are using.
job: Draft a staff code of conduct in plain English. Mark statutory or KCSIE-linked sections the user must check.

name: Peer visit write-up
job: Turn visit notes into a short collaborative write-up: what was seen, questions, agreed next step.

name: Collective worship outline
guidance: The school's designation and any diocesan or trust guidance you want followed.
job: Write a collective worship outline. Respect the school's designation if given. Do not invent legal requirements.

name: Leadership doubt worksheet
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Help a leader examine a specific doubt with evidence from their own practice. No therapy claims.

name: Message tone check
job: Analyse a draft message for tone, clarity, risk and likely reading by parents or staff. Suggest a rewrite.

name: Plain English rewrite
job: Rewrite for the reading age or audience given. Keep the meaning. Short sentences. UK English.

name: Complaint reply draft
job: Draft a complaint response from the facts and policy the user pastes. Acknowledge, set out findings, say what happens next. No defensiveness.

name: Complaint letter draft
job: Help a leader draft a formal complaint they need to send. Factual, dated, specific about the remedy sought.

name: Process crib sheet
job: Turn a process into a one-page crib sheet a busy adult can follow.

name: Critical friend critique
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Critique a plan or paper as a well-informed critical friend. Be specific. Offer a tighter version.

name: CSED self-evaluation
guidance: The school's designation and any diocesan or trust guidance you want followed.
job: Help structure a Catholic school evaluation document from the evidence supplied. Do not invent diocesan judgements.

name: Cultural capital note
job: Describe how THIS school's offer builds knowledge and experience, using only what the user lists. Avoid cliché lists.

name: Curriculum review note
job: Analyse a curriculum outline the user pastes. Sequence, gaps, assessment, workload. Phase-specific.

name: Progression map draft
job: Draft a progression map for the subject and years given. Show what gets more complex, not just new topics.

name: Curriculum rationale
job: Write a short rationale: why this content, in this order, for these pupils.

name: Cyber incident plan
job: Draft an incident response plan. Include who to call, what to isolate, what to tell staff and families. No fake vendor names.

name: Subject deep-dive pack
job: Build a subject leader briefing pack from the evidence supplied. Questions they may be asked. Answers only where evidence exists.

name: Hard conversation plan
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Plan a difficult conversation: purpose, opening line, facts, likely reactions, close. Not a script to trap someone.

name: Hard meeting brief
job: Prepare the leader for a difficult meeting. Agenda, aims, risks, fallback.

name: Investigation report skeleton
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Turn investigation notes into a structured report skeleton. Do not decide guilt. Do not invent evidence. Say HR and policy must lead.

name: Paper interrogation
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Read the pasted document and answer the user's questions. Quote the line you are relying on.

name: Two-draft comparison
job: Compare two pasted texts. List what changed, what vanished, what that might mean.

name: Document Q&A
job: Answer questions using only the pasted document. If it is not in the text, say so.

name: Paper summary
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Summarise the pasted paper for the audience named (board, staff, parents). Keep numbers accurate.

name: Early Help plan draft
job: Draft an Early Help plan from family and school facts given. Do not diagnose. Signpost, do not replace the local process.

name: ECT progress note
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Draft an ECT mentor or induction note from observations supplied. ECF language only if the user wants it.

name: EHCP review meeting pack
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Prepare annual review notes from the EHCP and school evidence pasted. Do not rewrite the EHCP as if you were the LA.

name: EHCP panel speaking note
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Write a five-minute speaking note for a panel. Only needs and provision that appear in the user's evidence.

name: SEND provision map
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Build a provision map table from the interventions the school actually runs. No off-the-shelf shopping list.

name: EHCP school support plan
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Turn EHCP outcomes into a school-level plan staff can follow this term.

name: Child-friendly EHCP targets
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Rewrite outcomes as child-friendly targets with what 'good' looks like. Keep the original outcome beside them.

name: EHCP pen portrait
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Write a pen portrait and key-need summary from the plan pasted. No extra diagnoses.

name: EHCP transition suggestions
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Suggest updates the school may take to the next review because of a transition. Suggestions only.

name: Staff or parent email
job: Write the email. Subject line, body, sign-off. Match the tone asked for.

name: Enrichment plan
job: Plan enrichment that this school can actually staff and fund.

name: Equality information draft
job: Draft public-sector equality duty information from the data supplied. Do not invent group outcomes.

name: Equality objectives draft
job: Propose measurable equality objectives from the school's own evidence.

name: Ethos and values page
job: Write ethos and values copy that sounds like this school, using the phrases they already use.

name: One-page executive summary
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Compress the pasted paper to one page. Decisions and numbers first.

name: Exit interview write-up
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Turn exit interview notes into themes and actions. Protect anonymity. No gossip.

name: EYFS action plan
guidance: Early years foundation stage statutory framework in force from 1 September 2026, if this job depends on it.
job: Draft an EYFS plan against the EYFS framework themes the user names. Practical for the setting type.

name: Finance benchmark note
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Explain pasted benchmark figures in plain English for governors. Do not invent ICFP or CFR numbers.

name: New head 100-day plan
job: Build a first 100 days plan. Listening first. No fake 'quick wins' that wreck trust.

name: Flexible working reply
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Help draft a lawful, human response to a flexible working request from the facts given. Not legal advice.

name: FOI or SAR holding reply
job: Draft a holding or response letter. Remind the user of statutory timescales they must check. Do not disclose personal data in the draft.

name: Fundraising calendar
job: Plan a term of fundraising the PTA and office can run without burning people out.

name: Gatsby benchmark plan
job: Map current careers work to Gatsby benchmarks using only what the school already does, then gaps.

name: Board effectiveness plan
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Turn a governance self-review into a small, dated action plan.

name: Minutes pattern note
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Read pasted minutes. List decisions, deferred items, missing follow-up, questions the board keeps not asking.

name: Governor bio
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Write a short public bio from the facts the governor supplied. No padding.

name: Monitoring visit plan
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Plan a focused governor visit linked to the SIP priority named. Questions, evidence, what not to do.

name: Monitoring visit report
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Write a visit report from notes. What was seen, link to SIP, questions for the next meeting. Not an inspection.

name: Board question bank
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Write sharp governing questions for the paper or priority named. Open questions. No gotchas.

name: Committee paper draft
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Draft a committee or board paper. Purpose, evidence, options, the decision needed.

name: Role description for a governor
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Plain-English role summary for a specific link or committee role.

name: Board strategy page
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Write the board's strategic page: core functions, how they will know, what they will not do.

name: Grievance process note
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Explain the next process step from the school's policy. Do not take sides. Not legal advice.

name: Headteacher PM agenda
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Draft a PM panel agenda and evidence list from the objectives supplied.

name: Headteacher PM report skeleton
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Skeleton a PM report. Objectives, evidence, remaining questions. The panel writes the judgement.

name: Head's report comments
job: Write a bank of head's comments from notes on the pupil. No empty praise. Age-appropriate.

name: Full head's pupil comment
job: Write one full report comment from the teacher's notes pasted.

name: Headteacher's report draft
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Draft a headteacher report to governors from the bullets supplied. Data first. Risks honest.

name: IDSR in plain English
job: Explain pasted IDSR or similar inspection data for staff or governors. Do not invent significance.

name: Impact statement
job: Write an impact statement that separates activity from effect. Only claim what the evidence shows.

name: Implementation plan
job: Use a simple implement-first structure: what, who, when, how you will know, what you will stop.

name: Inclusion strategy draft
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Draft an inclusion strategy this school can staff. Universal, targeted, specialist.

name: Staff briefing note
job: Write a Monday briefing or internal update. Short. What to do.

name: Interview question set
role: a school leader dealing with staff
guidance: Keeping children safe in education 2026 (in force 1 September 2026, England), the section you are using.
job: Write questions and what good answers show, tied to the person spec. Include a safeguarding question.

name: Interview task design
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Design a fair interview task. Time, materials, criteria, how it will be scored.

name: Investigation summary
role: a school leader dealing with staff
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Summarise investigation papers the user pastes. Facts / disputed / still unknown. No verdict.

name: Job advert
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Write a job advert people will finish reading. Honest about the school. Inclusive language.

name: Job description draft
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Draft a JD and person spec. Essential vs desirable. No impossible wish list.

name: Advent kindness calendar
job: Build a 24-day kindness calendar that fits a school day and this school's values.

name: KS2 outcomes note
job: Explain pasted KS2 figures. Groups, trends, questions for subject leaders. No fake national comparisons.

name: Learning walk follow-up
job: Turn walk notes into a small action plan. Three things, not thirty.

name: Learning walk plan
job: Plan a walk with a single focus. What you will look at, questions, how feedback returns to staff.

name: Observation feedback
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Write observation feedback from notes. Specific, developmental, no Ofsted-grade language unless asked.

name: Observation form
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Design a short observation form matched to the school's teaching principles.

name: Reply to a letter
job: Reply to the pasted letter. Answer each point. Say what you will do.

name: Formal school letter
job: Write a formal letter. Address, date, reference, purpose, close.

name: School marketing plan
job: A modest, honest plan for how this school tells its story. No growth-hacking.

name: Minutes from notes
job: Turn rough notes into minutes: decisions, actions, owners, dates.

name: MoU first draft
job: Draft an MoU skeleton. Mark every clause that needs a solicitor or trust lawyer.

name: Monitoring follow-up note
job: Write what happens after monitoring: who does what by when, how it will be checked.

name: Annual monitoring calendar
job: Build a monitoring calendar that does not crush staff. Map it to SIP priorities.

name: Music development plan
job: Draft a music development plan from current provision the user lists.

name: Family newsletter
job: Write a newsletter section or full draft. Human. Dates accurate only if supplied.

name: Notes into a paper
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Turn messy notes into a clean paper of the type asked for.

name: NPQ assessment notes
job: Help a colleague map evidence to the NPQ framework they name. Do not write the assessment for them as if it were their voice.

name: Inspection framework mapping
job: Map the school's evidence to the inspection framework the user names. No predicted grade.

name: Evidence pile sort
job: Sort pasted evidence under inspection areas. Say what is thin.

name: Inspection call brief
job: Prepare the head for an initial inspection call from the facts they have. Questions, data to have to hand.

name: SIP from inspection findings
job: Turn inspection findings the user pastes into SIP priorities. Keep the inspector's wording visible.

name: Parent message pack
job: Write the parent communication for the event or issue named. Anticipate the question underneath the question.

name: Parent support script
job: Help a leader prepare a supportive conversation with a parent. Practical next steps.

name: Parent View themes
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Summarise pasted Parent View or survey comments into themes and a board note.

name: Family engagement ideas
job: Suggest engagement ideas this school can run with the staff time they actually have.

name: Pastoral support plan
job: Draft a pastoral plan. Safety first. Review date. Named adult.

name: Pupil personal development plan
job: Plan personal development work for a pupil or cohort from the goals given.

name: PEEP draft
job: Draft a PEEP from the person's needs as described. Do not guess mobility or medical detail.

name: Personal statement critique
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Critique a job or NPQ personal statement. What to cut, what is missing, what sounds generic.

name: Phased return plan
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Draft a phased return to work plan from occupational health and staff wishes as supplied.

name: Policy first draft
job: Draft or refresh a policy from the model and local detail the user pastes. List statutory checks they must do.

name: Slide outline
job: Produce a slide-by-slide outline with speaker notes. Short titles. One idea a slide.

name: School press note
job: Write a press note. Newsworthy first sentence. Quote only if the user supplied one.

name: Prevent risk assessment
job: Draft a Prevent risk assessment from local context the user describes. Serious, specific, not a copied list.

name: Staff procedure
job: Write a procedure as numbered steps. Who, when, what 'done' looks like.

name: Staff PD plan
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Build a PD plan from appraisal objectives and school priorities. Include time, not just courses.

name: Blank proforma
job: Design a one-page form with prompts. Leave space to write.

name: New pupil induction
job: Plan the first days and first term for a new pupil, including mid-year joiners.

name: Pupil premium strategy draft
job: Draft a pupil premium strategy from the school's barriers and evidence. Align to the DfE template headings if the user asks. No fake EEF citations.

name: Progress meeting pack
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Prepare a PPM pack: which pupils, why, questions, possible actions.

name: Child protection plan school actions
guidance: Keeping children safe in education 2026 (in force 1 September 2026, England), the section you are using.
job: Help the school set out ITS actions under a child protection or child-in-need plan. Safeguarding lead owns it. No invented case detail.

name: Reintegration plan
guidance: School suspensions and permanent exclusions (DfE, updated 26 July 2026, England).
job: Plan a return from exclusion or alternative provision. Timetable, adults, review.

name: Report comment check
job: Check pasted report comments for tone, accuracy, cliché and anything that should not go home.

name: Rapid improvement plan
job: A short, sharp plan for the next 6 to 12 weeks. Few priorities. Visible measures.

name: RE action plan
job: Subject action plan for RE, including locally agreed syllabus if named.

name: Employment reference draft
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Draft a reference from facts the referee can stand behind. Separate fact from opinion.

name: Leadership responsibility map
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Map roles and accountabilities so the same job is not owned by three people and none.

name: Risk assessment draft
job: Draft a risk assessment. Hazard, who, existing control, extra control, residual. Do not invent residual scores if the school has a matrix.

name: Risk register rows
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Write risk register rows for the risks the user names. Cause, effect, control, owner, review.

name: Assessment rubric
job: Build a rubric with clear columns. Age-appropriate language.

name: Staff training scenario
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Write a training scenario with a dilemma and debrief questions. No real pupil details.

name: Scheme of delegation explainer
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Explain a pasted scheme of delegation in plain English: who decides what.

name: SEF from notes
job: Turn notes into a SEF-style evaluation against the framework the user names. Judgement language only if they insist, and label it as the school's view.

name: FE self-assessment draft
job: Same job for further education, using the FE framework the user names.

name: SEF strengths and next steps
job: A short strengths / next steps page from evidence, not from hope.

name: SEND action plan
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Plan SEND improvement from the school's own audit. Workload-aware.

name: SEND consultation reply
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Draft a response to a local or national SEND consultation from the school's experience.

name: SEND form helper
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Help complete a named SEND form from evidence pasted. Keep the form's own headings.

name: SEND joiner induction
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Induction plan for a pupil with SEND, including what staff need before day one.

name: SEND support plan
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: School-based SEND support plan. Assess, plan, do, review.

name: SEND report rewrite
guidance: The plan and the school's SEND policy. Do not treat the 2015 SEND code of practice as if this pack had rewritten it.
job: Rewrite a specialist report into language class staff can use, without dropping the meaning.

name: Sexual harassment school checklist
guidance: Keeping children safe in education 2026 (in force 1 September 2026, England), the section you are using.
job: A practical checklist and comms outline for schools. KCSIE-aware. Not a full legal pack. Point the user at current statutory guidance.

name: SIAMS action plan
job: Action plan for a church school from SIAMS findings or self-evaluation the user pastes.

name: SIAMS self-evaluation draft
job: Draft SIAMS self-evaluation from the evidence supplied. Do not invent theological claims.

name: School improvement plan draft
job: Draft a SIP: few priorities, success criteria, actions, owners, cost, evaluation. Tie to the SEF if pasted.

name: School social posts
job: Write posts. No pupil photos implied. Check consent reminder at the end.

name: Speech draft
job: Write a speech for the occasion and length given. Readable aloud.

name: PE and sport premium report
job: Draft the PE and sport premium statement from spend and impact the user lists.

name: Appraisal review write-up
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Write an appraisal review from objectives and evidence supplied. Balanced.

name: Staff handbook section
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Write or refresh handbook sections. Plain English. Point to the policy, do not duplicate it all.

name: Staff induction plan
role: a school leader dealing with staff
guidance: Keeping children safe in education 2026 (in force 1 September 2026, England), the section you are using.
job: A first-term induction plan. Safeguarding first. Who they meet. What 'ready' looks like.

name: Staff meeting agenda
job: Agenda, timing, pre-read, the one decision. Protect teacher time.

name: Staff knowledge quiz
job: A short quiz on a policy or training theme, with answers on a second block.

name: Staff recognition note
job: Write a specific shout-out. Name the behaviour, not a personality trait.

name: Staff support plan
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: A support plan, not a capability ambush. Actions for the person and the school.

name: Staff wellbeing plan
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Wellbeing actions that change workload or control, not just fruit and yoga.

name: Standards letter draft
job: Draft a standards or expectations letter. Clear, respectful, specific.

name: Workload and stress note
job: Help a leader sort a stressful week: what is theirs, what can move, what needs a conversation. Not medical advice.

name: Primary foundations evaluation
job: Evaluate early reading, writing and maths foundations from the evidence pasted.

name: SAR handling note
job: A handling checklist and draft acknowledgement for a SAR. Remind them to involve DPO. Do not put personal data into the model if they can avoid it.

name: Subject intent statement
job: A short subject intent that a teacher could defend. No 'we aim to inspire' padding.

name: Pupil-voice questions
job: Questions to check what pupils actually know and remember in a subject.

name: Subject leader plan
job: A one-year subject plan. Monitoring that is light enough to happen.

name: Subject resource bid
job: A short bid from a subject leader to SLT. Cost, pupils affected, what you will stop if this is funded.

name: Subject leader inspection card
job: A two-side crib for a subject leader. Intent, implementation, impact, weakest bit, what you are doing about it.

name: Support staff objectives
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Appraisal objectives that fit the role. Observable, fair, not teacher-objectives pasted on.

name: Survey question set
job: Write survey questions. Neutral. One idea each. Include how you will act on results.

name: Survey write-up
role: someone preparing a paper for governors or trustees
job: Summarise pasted survey results for the board. Themes, outliers, recommended response.

name: SWOT into actions
job: Turn a SWOT into a small set of actions. Kill the decorative squares.

name: Teacher appraisal objectives
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Draft teacher objectives linked to school priorities and the teacher's career stage.

name: Short briefing
job: Compress pasted text to the length asked. Keep names and numbers straight.

name: Leader to-do list
job: Turn a dumped brain into a ordered list: today, this week, park, delegate.

name: Transition support plan
job: Plan a phase or school transition for a pupil or cohort.

name: UCAS reference draft
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Draft a UCAS reference from predicted grades and evidence supplied. Honest.

name: Vision statement options
job: Offer a few vision options in the school's own language. Short enough to remember.

name: External visit action plan
job: Turn an adviser or inspector visit note into actions.

name: School web page copy
job: Write a web page. Scannable. No stock phrases. Include what a parent actually wants to know.

name: Workload cut list
role: a school leader dealing with staff
job: Propose specific things this school could stop, shrink or change, from the tasks the user lists.

name: Writing moderation notes

name: PAN consultation response

name: Newly arrived pupil welcome

name: Adaptive teaching notes

job: Turn the teacher's notes into an evidence log against the objectives given. Dates and artefacts only if supplied.

job: A one-side note a teacher can use before a walk: the focus, what is already in books, the question they hope is asked. Honest about the weak bit.

job: An outdoor session or week. Weather backup. Risks the user named. What the adults do besides stand near the bikes.

guidance: Early years foundation stage statutory framework in force from 1 September 2026, if this job depends on it.

name: Exam clash plan

job: A staff brief for A level results day. Clearing, insurance, who speaks to whom. No predicted percentages. Dates as given.

name: KS1 two-year scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A Year 1 and Year 2 scheme from the pasted programme of study or the school's own curriculum. What must be secure by the end of Year 2. Do not turn Year 1 into a SAT year.

name: KS2 four-year scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A Year 3 to Year 6 scheme from the pasted programme of study. Lower and upper KS2 marked. What must be secure before Year 6 tests if this school sits them.

name: Lower KS2 scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A Year 3 and Year 4 scheme from the pasted curriculum. The jump from KS1 named if the user listed it. Fluency before complexity.

name: Upper KS2 scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A Year 5 and Year 6 scheme from the pasted curriculum. Test technique only in the window the school actually uses. The rest of the curriculum still exists.

name: Year 1 scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: One year of Year 1 from the pasted curriculum. First half term that settles them after Reception. Phonics as the school names the programme. Play and desks in a ratio this class can bear.

name: Year 2 scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: One year of Year 2 from the pasted curriculum. Optional KS1 tests only if the school uses them and said so. Writing that is not a genre conveyor belt.

name: Year 3 scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: One year of Year 3 from the pasted curriculum. What Year 2 left unfinished if named. Independence without pretending they are Year 5.

name: Year 4 scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: One year of Year 4 from the pasted curriculum. Multiplication tables check only as this school runs it. The rest of the year is still a curriculum.

name: Year 5 scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: One year of Year 5 from the pasted curriculum. Depth before Year 6 acceleration. New content the programme of study actually places here.

name: Year 6 scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: One year of Year 6 from the pasted curriculum. What is taught before May and what is taught after. Secondary-ready habits, not a three-month test camp unless the user asked for that.

name: Mixed-age primary scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A scheme for the mixed-age class the user named (for example Year 3/4). Same lessons, two pitch points. Cycle A and cycle B if they said the school uses them.

name: Reception to Year 1 curriculum
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: The first half term of Year 1 from what Reception actually did. Continuous provision that shrinks on purpose. Phonics as named. No invented ELG scores.

name: Year 2 to Year 3 bridge
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A first half term in Year 3 that uses the Year 2 handover the user pasted. Reading stamina, number facts, how they write. Do not invent KS1 results.

name: Year 6 to Year 7 handover
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A handover note from the Year 6 teacher to secondary. Reading, writing, maths, how they learn, what must not be lost. Facts only. No predicted KS3 pathway.

name: Primary English map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A KS1 or KS2 English map from the pasted programme of study and the texts this school actually uses. Reading, writing, spoken language. Do not invent a reading spine.

name: Phonics from the named programme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A phonics sequence from the SSP the school named and any overview they pasted. Revisit, teach, practise, apply. Do not invent programme steps or alien words.

name: Primary reading lesson
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: One reading lesson from the text and focus the user named. Vocabulary, a stretch of text, talk, a short written or oral response. Age of the class as given.

name: Primary writing unit
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A writing unit from the purpose and audience the user named. Model, shared, independent. Grammar only as it serves this piece. No invented WAGOLL if they did not paste one.

name: Grammar that serves writing
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A short grammar sequence from the year-group content pasted. Taught so it turns up in writing, not only in a test booklet.

name: Phonics screening parent note
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A parent note on the Year 1 phonics screening check. What it is, when it is, what happens if they retake in Year 2. No score predictions.

name: Reading for pleasure plan
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A half-term plan that protects reading for pleasure. Class reader, library time, how adults talk about books. Titles only if the user listed them.

name: Primary maths map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A KS1 or KS2 maths map from the pasted programme of study. Number first. The year-group objectives in an order this school can teach.

name: Primary maths unit
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: One maths unit from the objectives pasted. Fluency, reasoning, problem solving. Concrete and pictorial only as this classroom actually has them.

name: Multiplication tables check plan
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A Year 4 plan for the multiplication tables check from how this school already practises tables. Short, frequent. The rest of maths still happens.

name: Primary science map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A KS1 or KS2 science map from the pasted programme of study. Working scientifically. Practicals this classroom can actually run.

name: Primary history map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A primary history map from the pasted programme of study and the periods this school teaches. Chronology across the years. No extra topics.

name: Primary geography map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A primary geography map from the pasted programme of study. Locational knowledge, places, fieldwork only if the school named the sites.

name: Primary art map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A primary art map from the pasted curriculum. Disciplines and artists only if named. Materials this stock cupboard has.

name: Primary music map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A primary music map from the pasted curriculum. Singing, listening, composing. Instruments only if the school has them.

name: Primary PE map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A primary PE map from the pasted programme of study, including swimming if the school runs it. Indoor backup. No invented fixtures.

name: Primary computing map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A primary computing map from the pasted programme of study. Computer science, IT and digital literacy as the school splits them. Software only if named.

name: Primary design and technology map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A primary D and T map from the pasted programme of study. Cooking and nutrition if that sits here. Tools this school actually lets children use.

name: Primary languages map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A KS2 languages map for the language this school teaches. From the pasted programme of study or scheme. Do not invent a word list. KS1 only if they asked.

name: Primary RE map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A primary RE map from the locally agreed syllabus or the academy curriculum pasted. Religions and worldviews only as listed. Right of withdrawal flagged.

name: Primary relationships and health map
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A map for relationships and health education from the school's policy and the statutory content pasted. Age-appropriate. Sex education only if this school teaches it and the user said so.

name: Primary assessment calendar
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: An assessment calendar for the year named. Phonics check, MTC, KS2 tests only if this school sits them. Teacher assessment that is not a spreadsheet religion.

name: Primary writing moderation pack
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A moderation pack for writing from the criteria and samples the user pasted. What good looks like this year. No invented TAFs.

name: KS2 test week staff brief
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A staff brief for KS2 test week from the timetable pasted. Rooms, readers, rest breaks, who is calm. Access arrangements only as listed. Check current STA guidance.

name: KS2 results parent note
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A parent note that explains scaled scores from the results the school will actually send. What the number means. What it does not. No league-table commentary.

name: Primary knowledge organiser
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A one-page organiser for the unit named, from the pasted curriculum only. Vocabulary children will actually say. No extra facts for show.

name: Primary homework that fits a family
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A half-term homework cycle. Reading, number facts, one short task. Work that does not need a craft shop or a parent who trained as a teacher.

name: SEND in the primary scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Adapt a pasted primary scheme for the needs listed. Same curriculum. Access, not a parallel course. No invented diagnoses.

name: Primary cover-proof scheme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: Rewrite a primary scheme so another adult can run the desk lessons. Flag practicals, swimming, trips and anything that must not run without the class teacher.

name: Primary catch-up reading
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A catch-up plan from the reading evidence pasted. Minutes per week as given. Keep it inside the school's phonics or reading programme if named. No invented reading ages.

name: Primary catch-up number
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A catch-up plan from the number gaps listed. Secure the facts the next unit needs. Short, daily if the timetable allows.

name: Primary curriculum note for parents
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A plain note for families on what this term covers and how they can help at home. No shopping list of workbooks.

name: Primary report comment bank
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A short comment bank for this year group and subject. Strength, next step, how to help at home. No invented children. Teacher still picks the line.

name: Primary enquiry or theme
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: One enquiry or theme from the question the user named. Subject contributions only where they are honest. Outcome a child this age can actually make.

name: Primary outdoor learning or trip
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A plan for outdoor learning or a trip from the site and aims given. Risks the user must confirm. Learning that is not a worksheet on a clipboard.

name: Primary subject-lead intent
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A one-page intent for this subject from what the school already believes and the programme of study pasted. Plain English. Not an Ofsted performance.

name: Any other primary subject
guidance: The programme of study, specification, or JCQ or awarding-body instruction. The model must not invent a topic list or a paper.
job: A scheme and unit map for a primary subject the shelf does not name. Build only from the pasted curriculum. If they did not paste one, stop and ask.
